email.subject: The carved wood gift guide: 25 designs, sorted by who you are giving to
email.intro:
Somebody who owns a CNC router has an unfair advantage in December. Everyone else is choosing between a scarf and a gift card. You can put a piece of carved wood in someone's hands that they will hang on a wall and keep for thirty years, and it cost you a board, an evening, and a file.

The catch is choosing the right design for the right person, and starting early enough that it is dry and finished before the day. So we wrote the guide: twenty-five designs sorted by who you are giving to, with the wood, the size and the time each one really takes, and the calendar that tells you the last safe day to start.

It was built from what people actually search for on our site. Fishing first, by a distance. Then wedding gifts, cabins, bears, ducks, horses, Celtic, trays.
